name: What if I want a kitchen that works for entertaining?

mainEntity.name: How should a kitchen remodel be designed if I use the space mainly for entertaining guests?
mainEntity.text: How should a kitchen remodel be designed if I use the space mainly for entertaining guests?

acceptedAnswer.text: If entertaining is the main goal, the kitchen should support both performance and presentation. That usually means an open layout, generous island seating, clear sightlines to dining or living areas, and easy movement between cooking, serving, and social zones. Good lighting matters because the room needs to function well during prep and still look inviting at night. Storage should include a place to hide clutter quickly so the kitchen can transition from work mode to guest-ready. In Los Angeles homes, indoor-outdoor flow is especially valuable because patios and backyards often become part of the entertaining space. The design should protect the cooking triangle or work zones while keeping guests from crossing the most active parts of the room. The most successful entertaining kitchens look polished but still operate like a real workspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: An entertaining-focused kitchen usually needs open sightlines, enough seating, a large island, strong lighting, ample prep and serving space, and good traffic flow to adjacent indoor and outdoor areas. The design should keep guests out of the main cooking path.
